The first release of ID Card Printing Software Free as a Windows program.

### Highlights
- **Its own window.** No web browser needed. Closing the window keeps the program running in the notification area, so cards keep printing.
- **Card sizes.** Each template can be CR80 (85.6 × 54 mm), CR79, CR100 or a custom size, portrait or landscape.
- **Updates itself.** Administrators see when a new version is available and can install it with **Update now**.
- **A normal installer.** Licence agreement, choice of folder (Program Files by default), shortcuts, and it installs the Microsoft .NET 10 runtimes and WebView2 if they're missing. Listed in *Add or remove programs* with an uninstaller that keeps your data.
- **Cleaner screens.** Less clutter, same features.
- **64-bit**, built on .NET 10 (long-term support).

### Upgrading from 2.x
Run the setup on the same PC and Windows account. Your clients, people, templates, history, users and backups carry over unchanged. Older 2.x backups restore in 3.0.

### Install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.0.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.

Requires Windows 10 (1809 or later) or Windows 11, 64-bit, and a card printer with its Windows driver installed.
